content: Dɑfidi u kɑnɑru kuɑ u nɛɛ,

content.text: Yinni Gusunɔ, ɑ mɑn swɑɑ dɑkio kpɑ ɑ nɛn kɑnɑru nɔ.
Wee nɑ sɑ̃ɑru kɑ wɔnwɔndu soore.
A nɛn hunde beruo, domi nɑ rɑ nun sɑ̃.
Gusunɔ, nɑ nun nɑɑnɛ sɑ̃ɑ,
ɑ mɑn fɑɑbɑ koowo.
Yinni, wunɑ nɑ rɑ nɔɔɡiru sue bɑɑdommɑ.
A mɑn wɔnwɔndu kuo.
Yinni, ɑ mɑn nuku dobu wɛ̃ɛyɔ.
Wunɑ nɑ rɑ n kɑnɑmɔ kɑ nɛn ɡɔ̃ru kpuro.
Yinni, ɑ sɑ̃ɑwɑ tɔn ɡeo,
ɑ rɑ mɑɑ tɔmbu ben durum wɔke.
A rɑ be bɑ nun soku kpuro kĩru sɔ̃ɔsi tɑ n kpɑ̃.
Yinni Gusunɔ, ɑ nɛn kɑnɑru nɔɔwɔ.
A nɛn weeweenu swɑɑ dɑkio.
Domi nɑ̀ n nun kɑnɑ nɔni swɑ̃ɑrun sɑɑ,
ɑ rɑ mɑn wisi.
Gɑ̃ɑnu sɑri ni nu kɑ nun weenɛ ye bɑ rɑ sɑ̃ kpuro sɔɔ.
Gɑ̃ɑnu mɑɑ sɑri ni nu kɑ wunɛn sɔmɑ weenɛ.
Bwese ni ɑ tɑkɑ kuɑ kpuro nu koo nɑ nu yiirɑ wunɛn wuswɑɑɔ,
kpɑ nu wunɛn yĩsiru bɛɛrɛ wɛ̃.
Domi ɑ kpɑ̃, ɑ rɑ mɑɑ sɔm mɑɑmɑɑkiɡinu ko.
Wunɛ turowɑ ɑ sɑ̃ɑ Gusunɔ.
Yinni Gusunɔ, ɑ mɑn wunɛn swɛɛ sɔ̃ɔsio,
kpɑ n wɑ n sĩ wunɛn ɡem sɔɔ.
A de n wunɛn yĩsiru nɑsiɑ.
Gusunɔ nɛn Yinni, kon nun siɑrɑ kɑ nɛn ɡɔ̃ru kpuro,
kpɑ n nun bɛɛrɛ wɛ̃ sere kɑ bɑɑdommɑɔ.
Domi ɑ mɑn durom bɑkɑm kuɑ,
ɑ mɑn yɑrɑ ɡɔribun wɑ̃ɑ yerun sɔɔ sɔɔn di.
Yinni Gusunɔ, tii suobu bɑ mɑn seesi.
Tɔn kɔ̃sobu bɑ kĩ bu mɑn hunde wunɑ,
be, bèn bwisikunu ku rɑ n wɑ̃ɑ wunɛn mi ɡiɑ.
Adɑmɑ wunɛ Gusunɔ, ɑ sɑ̃ɑwɑ Yinni wɔnwɔnduɡii.
A ku rɑ mɔru se fuuku.
Wunɛn kĩru tɑ kpɑ̃.
A mɑɑ sɑ̃ɑwɑ bɔrɔkini.
A mɑn mɛɛrimɑ kpɑ ɑ nɛn wɔnwɔndu wɑ.
A nɛ, wunɛn sɔm kowo dɑm kɛ̃ɛyɔ,
kpɑ ɑ mɑn fɑɑbɑ ko nɛ, wunɛn sɔm kowon bii.
Yinni Gusunɔ, ɑ mɑn yĩreru sɔ̃ɔsio te tɑ koo mɑn koorɑ,
kpɑ ɑ de nɛn yibɛrɛbɑ bu ye wɑ kpɑ sekuru tu bu mwɑ.
Domi wunɑ ɑ rɑ mɑn fɑɑbɑ ko, kpɑ ɑ mɑn nukuru yɛmiɑsiɑ.
